Commercial interiors · Design & build

Dubai Police Officers’ Club Lounge

Al Wasl, Dubai

Project value
AED 720,000
Duration
2 months
Completed
2018

Project overview

The interior was arranged around three meeting rooms and two lounge areas. Vertical timber slats continued into the ceiling to divide the space.

The finishes included timber wall cladding, green marble, glass partitions, integrated screens, cove lighting, and suspended circular lights. The scope covered design and build of the interior.

Project team: Joga Ram Group
Source: 2021 portfolio, pages 24–25
